d: Last Thursday in Bhopal, the Madhya Pradesh government introduced five initiatives to help its firms leverage India’s free trade agreements, before an audience of over 800 exporters. The initiatives include a strategic plan, a handbook, a portal module and an accelerator, but the most unassuming yet potentially most beneficial is a dedicated FTA helpdesk. It provides exporters with a single telephone number and email address and commits to responding to inquiries on rules of origin, certificates and standards within two working days.
